purpose: Correct the interpretation of the pre-registration Git screen by checking local Codex session records before the first BDUK candidate commit.

screen.result: Exact title, URL and answer-value matches occur before the first Git registration, but only within the 8-minute candidate preparation window. No earlier exact match was found in the scanned local rollout records. Repeated tool call and tool output records are not independent exposures.

interpretation: The zero-match historical Git tree is not a zero-exposure proof: the same-session preparation preceded its first commit. The observed pre-commit rollout matches do not by themselves establish exposure during older product development. Candidate preparation is documented exposure and must stay within this single GOV.UK source-family unit.
limits: Exact-pattern search can miss paraphrases, alternative URLs, unrecorded conversations, binary contents or provider-side material.
This screen does not certify that the question family is independent of all product-development materials or that answer content is valid Gold.
The two user-confirmed answers remain content-only confirmations; family eligibility, freeze and G16 quality remain open.
